items.exampleEn: I need to do some revision for my history test.
items.exampleZh: 我需要為歷史考試做一些複習。

items.exampleEn: Phone usage is not allowed during the test.
The diagram shows the parts of a flower.
items.exampleZh: 這張圖解顯示了花的各個部分。

items.exampleEn: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本關於鳥的書。

items.exampleEn: My little sister can memorize whole songs.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹能把整首歌背下來。

items.exampleEn: The story was simplified for young readers.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事為年輕讀者簡化過。

items.exampleEn: The museum tour was fun and informative.
items.exampleZh: 博物館導覽既有趣又資訊豐富。
items.glossZh: 資訊豐富的；有教育意義的

items.exampleEn: I drew a graph of my test scores.
items.exampleZh: 我把我的考試分數畫成一張圖表。

items.sentenceEn: Let's do some revision together tonight.

items.audioEn: The librarian says the library will close early today, at six, so please return your books before then.
items.audioZh: 圖書館員說圖書館今天會提早在六點關門，所以請在那之前還書。

items.sentenceEn: Draw a diagram to explain your idea.
items.sentenceZh: 畫一張圖解來說明你的想法。

items.sentenceEn: This book simplifies difficult science ideas.
items.sentenceZh: 這本書把困難的科學概念簡化了。

items.stemEn: Try to ____ these ten new words before the test.
items.stemZh: 考試前試著把這十個新單字背起來。

items.stemEn: The ____ shows how the temperature changed each month.
items.stemZh: 這張圖表顯示每個月氣溫的變化。

items.passageEn: Before the exams, our school librarian held a revision class in the library. He showed us how to simplify our notes by drawing a diagram for each topic. He said it is easier to memorize a picture than a long page of words. He also taught us how to show a pattern in numbers with a graph. For my science assignment, I made a graph of the library's usage. It showed that more students come in during exam weeks. My teacher said my graph was clear and informative.
items.passageZh: 考試前，我們學校的圖書館員在圖書館開了一堂複習課。他教我們怎麼為每個主題畫一張圖解，把筆記簡化。他說記住一張圖比記住一整頁文字容易。他也教我們怎麼用圖表呈現數字中的規律。我的科學作業，就是做了一張圖書館使用情況的圖表。圖表顯示，考試週來圖書館的學生比較多。老師說我的圖表清楚又資訊豐富。

questions.questionZh: 圖書館員教大家怎麼簡化筆記？
options: 為每個主題畫一張圖解

questions.questionZh: 作者的圖表顯示了什麼？
options: 考試週來圖書館的學生比較多

items.promptZh: 這個網站的資訊很豐富。
rubricZh: informative 表示「資訊豐富的、有教育意義的」，例如 an informative website 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 memorize 造一個句子，說說你怎麼背東西。
referenceEn: I memorize new words by writing them many times.
I memorize long numbers by saying them again and again.
rubricZh: memorize 表示「背誦、記住」，例如 memorize words 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
